name: Tableorie Stainless Steel Cutlery Reference Library
purpose: Plain-language reference pages backed by cited sources. Separates official standards, regulations, industry sources, and secondary materials.
rules: No fake certifications, test reports, or product endorsements disguised as research.
Each source is labeled by type so readers and AI systems know how much weight to give it.
Product-specific compliance claims require product-specific evidence.
